title: 第8章 虚穹改第9章 虚穹二改
content_zh:
“虚穹”：指宇宙中的虚空和广阔无垠的天空。
“我，你，你怎么又来了？”作家这回可是更加懵了，因为几天前送回去的白凌又莫名其妙地出现在法师塔，而且依旧是围着浴布的装扮。
“我哪里知道，这太讨厌了！一回家洗澡就又回到这里了！”白凌气急败坏地说。
“气死我了！快送我回去！”白凌拉着作家的手就往大门那边走去。
“唉唉！等下！你以为我这里是公共厕所啊？想来就来想走就走？再说你来的不是时候，我正要去别的地方，想要再去你那里可能要过一段时间，去找件衣服吧，可能有你能穿的衣服。”作家无奈地摇了摇头，指了指身后的卧室说道。
“法师塔启动传送后，想要再次启动可不是短时间的事。”
“那可怎么办？我明天可是要上班的，有一个重要的会议要参加呢。”白凌扶额，不知道如何面对。
“我没说过我的法师塔是可以游走于时空之中吗？既来之则安之，你可以跟着我去别的世界走走，到时候我再将你送回你的时间里就行了。”作家挥动着食指，心想这普通地球人对法师塔的能力如此缺乏了解，还真是一种“不尊重”呢。
“真的吗？那太棒了！”因为第二次来而有些兴奋，白凌在作家的房间里找到白衬衣和男式牛仔裤后，也只能将就着穿这些了。
当白凌换好衣服回来时，作家早已站在法师塔门前。看到白凌出来，作家随即打开门，“欢迎来到另一个世界！”外面的光芒映射进来，略显发白的树林山石出现在门外。不管之前身处何处，但现在这门外面绝对不是地球。
“等我看一下是否能随意进入……很好，我们走。”作家打开光幕查看数据，没发现什么特别之处，于是直接收起光幕。只是就在他收起光幕的同时，某个数据闪现出红色光芒，可惜作家没有看到。
两人一起走出门，门开在大石之上。等两人进入这个世界，四周的景色才映入眼帘。灰白色的树林，四周的植物皆是如此模样，没有一点声音，就连虫鸣鸟叫也听不到。
“这里是不是发生过大火？到处都是这种灰白色，这里的树木好像都石化了一样。”白凌伸手去捏一根树枝，树枝被捏后直接粉碎。
“这里一定产生过极高的温度，所以森林才会碳化成这个样子。”作家蹲下身子，抓了一把身下的地面，手里只有沙子和灰尘。
“草木想要在这样的土壤里生长几乎是不可能的。”作家好奇地看着手里的沙子，抬起头来，显然对这里很感兴趣。
“一片石化的森林，真是不可思议。”白凌也同样被这奇异的世界所震惊。
“好像有魔法的痕迹，我得调查调查，不过我好像有吸引麻烦的体质，得小心进行，比如眼前这个就是个大麻烦。”作家小声嘀咕着，看了一眼白凌所在的方向。
在石化森林里，两人一同前进。路上满是石化的植物，甚至还有一只如牛般大小的石化动物。它的出现吓了白凌一跳，不过见到是石头的，白凌就只是惊叹于造物的神奇了。
“它原本是活的吗？”白凌看着石化的动物，突然问道。
“嗯，我想是的。不知道是什么动物，不过这里一定发生过不好的事情，几乎将目之所及的所有地方都石化了，什么生命都没有了……”作家摇了摇头说道。

“我们一定可以回去的，是吧？”白凌望向即将走出的森林尽头说道。
“我会带你回去的，放心，我说到做到。”作家笃定地回答。
“作家！你看！那是什么！”白凌指着森林外远方的一片建筑群惊讶地喊道。
“让我看看！”作家也随之赶来，放眼望去，白凌所指的地方是白色的建筑群。从样式来看，极具科技感，几乎就是人们心里所描绘的未来城市的样子。
“真不可思议。”作家掏出短小的法杖，直接在自己的眼睛上一抹，施展出“遥远之眼”。随后，就像是望远镜一样的效果出现在作家的眼前。仔细看过去，那巨大的城市里虽然看上去繁荣，但根本没有任何生命气息存在，哪里都没有。毫无生气，只有建筑矗立在那里。
“你会魔法？”看到施展魔法的作家，白凌感到有些不可思议。
“难道你就没有考虑过为什么我呆的地方叫法师塔吗？我是一名魔法师，我当然会魔法。”作家不屑地指出白凌一直没有注意到的地方。
“我还以为你用的是外星科技呢！”白凌有些思维混乱，但好在她神经比较大条，感觉说是魔法比说是科技更能让人理解。
“你怎么想的，作家？”白凌满眼都是好奇，指着前面的那片城市问道。
“我不知道，不过有必要过去看看是什么情况。”作家收起魔法，“我想我们走过去能了解得更多。”
“看天色有些晚了，为了安全起见，我想我们今晚还是先回到法师塔再说吧。”作家看了一眼那死寂的未来城市，拉着有些恋恋不舍的白凌往回走。
“我想是走这里没错吧。”作家有些不确定地向一个方向走去。只是四周总让人感觉有什么东西在一直盯着他们两人，让人感觉毛骨悚然。
虽然过程有些艰难，但他们还是看到了法师塔的门。可是就在这个时候，跟在后面的白凌突然感觉到肩头被什么东西直接拍了一下。这一下惊得白凌瞬间头皮发麻，回头看去，却什么也没有看到。
这周围不是没有生命存在吗？想到这里，白凌更加害怕了，直接跟上进入法师塔门口的作家，拉着他的手就不放开了。
“我真的被拍到了！就是这边的肩膀，真的不骗你！不是幻觉，就是有人拍了我一下！”白凌激动地解释自己之前被看不到的东西拍肩膀的事，可是作家在周围完全没有发现什么其他的人或是动物。
“没事，没事，你只是吓到了，有我在，别怕。”作家有模有样地拍了拍她的背，让白凌的神经松弛下来。他告诉白凌，只要法师塔的门关上了，就不会有任何人能进来，也许……也不绝对……
content_en:
"Void Vault": refers to the void and the vast sky in the universe.
"I, you, why are you here again?" The writer was even more confused this time, because Bai Ling, who was sent back a few days ago, appeared inexplicably in the Mage Tower again, still dressed in a bathcloth.
"How did I know? This is so annoying! As soon as I go home and take a shower, I'm back here again!" Bai Ling said angrily.
"I'm so angry! Send me back quickly!" Bai Ling took the writer's hand and walked towards the door.
"Ahem! Wait! Do you think this is a public toilet? You can come and leave whenever you want? Besides, you came at the wrong time. I'm going somewhere else. It may take a while before I can go to your place again. Let's go find some clothes. There may be clothes you can wear." The writer shook his head helplessly and pointed to the bedroom behind him.
"After the mage tower starts teleportation, it will not take a short time to start it again."
"What should I do? I have to go to work tomorrow, and I have an important meeting to attend." Bai Ling raised his forehead, not knowing how to face it.
"Didn't I say that my Mage Tower can travel in time and space? Once you come, you can make peace with it. You can follow me to other worlds, and then I will send you back to your time." The writer waved his index finger, thinking that it was really "disrespectful" for ordinary earthlings to have such a lack of understanding of the ability of the Mage Tower.
"Really? That's great!" Bai Ling was a little excited because of his second visit. After finding a white shirt and men's jeans in the writer's room, Bai Ling could only make do with these.
When Bai Ling came back after changing his clothes, the writer was already standing in front of the wizard's tower door. Seeing Bai Ling come out, the writer immediately opened the door and said, "Welcome to another world!" The light from outside reflected in, and the slightly white woods and rocks appeared outside the door. No matter where I was before, it was definitely not the earth outside this door now.
"Wait for me to see if I can enter at will... Very good, let's go." The writer opened the light curtain to check the data and found nothing special, so he closed the light curtain directly. But just as he closed the light curtain, a certain data flashed red light, but unfortunately the writer did not see it.
The two of them walked out of the door together, which was opened on the big stone. When the two entered this world, the surrounding scenery came into view. The gray-white woods and the surrounding plants all looked like this. There was no sound at all, not even the chirping of insects and birds.
"Has there been a fire here? This gray-white color is everywhere, and the trees here seem to be petrified." Bai Ling stretched out his hand to pinch a branch, and the branch was crushed directly after being pinched.
"There must have been extremely high temperatures here, so the forest was carbonized like this." The writer squatted down and grabbed a handful of the ground beneath him, with only sand and dust in his hands.
"It is almost impossible for vegetation to grow in such soil." The writer looked at the sand in his hand curiously and raised his head, obviously very interested in this place.
"A petrified forest is really incredible." Bai Ling was also shocked by this strange world.
"There seems to be traces of magic. I have to investigate, but I seem to have a constitution that attracts trouble, so I have to be careful. For example, the one in front of me is a big trouble." The writer muttered in a low voice and glanced in the direction of Bai Ling.
In the petrified forest, the two of them moved forward together. The road is covered with petrified plants and even a petrified animal the size of a cow. Its appearance startled Bai Ling, but seeing that it was made of stone, Bai Ling just marveled at the magic of creation.
"Was it originally alive?" Bai Ling looked at the petrified animal and asked suddenly.
"Well, I think so. I don't know what kind of animal it is, but something bad must have happened here. Almost everything in sight has been petrified, and there is no life left..." The writer shook his head and said.
"We can definitely go back, right? Bai Ling said looking towards the end of the forest he was about to walk out of.
"I will take you back, don't worry, I will do what I say. "The writer replied firmly.
"Writer! Look! What is that! Bai Ling pointed at a group of buildings in the distance outside the forest and shouted in surprise.
"Let me see! "The writer also came and looked around. The place Bai Ling was pointing to was a group of white buildings. Judging from the style, it was very technological, almost exactly what people imagined the future city to look like.
“It’s incredible. "The writer took out a short staff and touched it directly on his eyes to cast the "Distant Eye". Then, an effect like a telescope appeared in front of the writer's eyes. Looking carefully, although the huge city looked prosperous, there was no life at all. There was no life anywhere. There was no life, only buildings standing there.
"You know magic? "Bai Ling felt a little incredible when he saw the writer using magic.
"Have you never considered why the place I stay is called the Mage Tower? I am a magician, of course I can do magic. "The writer pointed out with disdain what Bai Ling had not noticed.
“I thought you were using alien technology! "Bai Ling's thinking is a little confused, but fortunately she is relatively smart. She feels that it is more understandable to say it is magic than technology.
“What do you think, writer? "Bai Ling's eyes were full of curiosity, and he pointed to the city in front and asked.
“I don’t know, but it’s necessary to go and see what’s going on. The writer put away his magic, "I think we can learn more if we go over there." "
"It's a little late looking at the sky. For safety reasons, I think we should go back to the Mage Tower tonight. "The writer took a look at the dead future city and pulled the somewhat reluctant Bai Ling back.
"I think this is the right place to go. "The writer walked in one direction with some uncertainty. But there was always a feeling that something was staring at the two of them, which made people feel creepy.
Although the process was a bit difficult, they still saw the door of the Mage Tower. But at this moment, Bai Ling, who was following behind, suddenly felt something tap directly on his shoulder. This shock made Bai Ling's scalp numb instantly. When he looked back, he saw nothing.
Isn't there no life around here? Thinking of this, Bai Ling became even more frightened. He followed the writer who entered the entrance of the mage tower and held his hand without letting go.
“I was actually photographed! It’s the shoulder here, I’m not going to lie to you! It’s not a hallucination, it’s just someone taking a picture of me! Bai Ling explained excitedly that he had been tapped on the shoulder by something invisible before, but the writer did not find any other people or animals around him.
"It's okay, it's okay, you were just scared, I'm here, don't be afraid. "The writer patted her back gracefully to relax Bai Ling's nerves. He told Bai Ling that as long as the door of the mage tower is closed, no one can come in, maybe... not definitely...
